title: 匯入學員資料 — Admin Preview-then-Confirm
content:
實作管理員由 CSV / XLSX 匯入學員 User profile 的 preview → confirm 流程。User 是姓名、聯絡方式及身份證件資料的唯一來源；此流程不建立課程 Registrant 或付款資料。

AF-019 擁有共用 parser 的標題辨識責任：略過開頭全空白列，第一個非空白列必須包含所有範本標題（大小寫不敏感、順序可變）；缺欄或結構不符即回傳結構錯誤及零資料列。AF-021 消費此契約，不在業務層重複實作 header parsing。

Preview 與 confirm 都接受 multipart/form-data 的 file。伺服器不保存檔案或預覽 session；confirm 由瀏覽器重新上傳同一檔案，伺服器重新解析與驗證。全檔案原子性：只有所有列均通過解析、格式、資料庫重複及檔案內重複檢查才可確認；任何無效列都阻止整批。確認時在單一 Prisma transaction 中建立所有 User，不逐列捕捉並吞掉 DB 錯誤；任一寫入失敗即回滾整批。超過 10MB、未授權或格式不符均回傳明確錯誤。

comments.name: User
comments.text: Approved design decisions: User owns canonical identity data; no server-side preview store; imports are all-or-nothing.

acceptance: CSV/XLSX leading fully blank rows are skipped; first nonblank row must contain every expected template header (case-insensitive; column order may vary)
Missing/mismatched headers return a structural error and cannot be confirmed
Preview shows first 20 rows with row-level validation errors; any invalid row blocks the entire import
Validation catches invalid email/phone, missing required fields, invalid ID data, database duplicates, and duplicates within the uploaded file
Confirm multipart request re-uploads the file; no importId or server-side preview store is used
Confirm reparses and revalidates, then creates all User records in one Prisma transaction; any DB failure rolls back all rows
User is the canonical source for ID document data; import does not create Registrant rows or overwrite existing users
Preview offers a CSV download of validation errors with source row, field, and message
Template download produces CSV + Excel with correct column headers
Admin UI has 3-step wizard: Upload → Preview → Result
Validation/structural errors are visible before confirm and can be exported as error details
File type validation (.csv, .xlsx only), max file size limit (10MB)
All UI labels use dict (i18n: en, zh-hk, zh-cn)
Integration test proves a failed database write leaves no rows from the batch
All changed UI copy is dictionary-driven for en, zh-hk, and zh-cn
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: src/lib/data/import/registrants.ts (update — User mapping and complete duplicate checks)
src/app/[locale]/admin/import/registrants/page.tsx (update — re-upload file, disable confirm unless all rows valid)
verification: Test CSV and XLSX with leading blank rows, valid/reordered headers, missing headers, row errors, and duplicate values. Confirm valid file creates all User records; a forced DB failure rolls the entire transaction back. Run npm run typecheck and npm run lint.
